title: Tax Desk Bulletin: Occupancy Tax and the Long-Stay Exemption on a Notice Charge
content:
# Tax desk bulletin — occupancy tax on the notice charge of a cancelled stay

**Rule.** A stay in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category whose nights are equal to or greater than the jurisdiction's exempt minimum nights carries no occupancy tax at all, except that a stay a guest cancellation leaves keeping fewer nights than that minimum carries, on its notice charge, the occupancy tax of every night kept.

The occupancy tax of the notice charge depends on whether the stay keeps its exemption:

1. **Exemption kept.** When the stay's nights reach the jurisdiction's exempt minimum and the nights kept — the nights up to and including the cancellation date, the notice nights kept and the part of the later nights kept — still reach it, the notice charge carries no occupancy tax.
2. **Exemption lost.** When the stay's nights reach the exempt minimum but the nights kept fall below it, the stay is no longer exempt and the notice charge carries the occupancy tax of every night kept: the percentage rate of the kept nights' price (the nights kept times the night price, to the cent) and of the cleaning, pet and extra-guest fees attributable to them (those three fees together, times the nights kept, divided by the stay's nights), plus the flat amount for each night kept, rounded half up to the cent.
3. **Any other stay.** The notice charge is taxed at the percentage rate of the notice charge's fee base plus the flat amount for each night it charges, rounded half up to the cent.

The jurisdiction is the one recorded on the stay.

## Jurisdiction figures

| Jurisdiction | Exempt minimum nights | Percentage rate | Flat amount per night |
|---|---|---|---|
| TX-AUSTIN | 30 | 17.00% | 0.00 |
| FL-ORANGE | 183 | 12.50% | 0.00 |
| CO-DENVER | 30 | 15.75% | 0.00 |
| TN-NASHVILLE | 30 | 15.25% | 2.50 |
| HI-HONOLULU | 180 | 17.96% | 0.00 |
| CA-SAN-DIEGO | 30 | 12.50% | 0.00 |

## Cases on both sides of the minimum (hypothetical CO-DENVER stays)

| Stay's nights | Nights kept | Branch |
|---|---|---|
| 45 | 40 | exemption kept: no occupancy tax on the notice charge |
| 45 | 30 | exemption kept: 30 still reaches the minimum of 30 |
| 45 | 20 | exemption lost: tax on every night kept |
| 29 | any | any other stay: rate of the fee base plus flat amounts |

## Worked figure for an exemption lost (hypothetical)

A 45-night CO-DENVER stay with a nightly subtotal of 4,500.00 (night price 100.00), a cleaning fee of 150.00 and no pet or extra-guest fee keeps 20 nights. Kept nights' price: 2,000.00. Fees attributable: 150.00 times 20 divided by 45, which is 66.6667. Tax: 15.75% of 2,066.6667 is 325.50, plus no flat amount: 325.50 on the notice charge.
